documents.title: Orthopedic clinic visit
documents.author: S. Rehman (Orthopedics)
documents.text:
Chief complaint: left knee pain for 6 months.
History: Pain makes it difficult to walk to the market and to pray on the floor. Patient reports doing some exercises at home for the knee.
Assessment: Chronic left knee pain, possible early osteoarthritis.
Plan: Request MRI of the left knee without contrast.

documents.title: X-ray report, left knee
documents.author: Radiology department
documents.text:
Examination: X-ray of the left knee, weight-bearing views, performed on 15 Aug 2026.
Impression: Mild degenerative change. No fracture.
